name: Team Game Scoreboard
use_when: A group wants to keep score of a head-to-head game like beer pong, darts, or ping pong between two teams of one or two players, played as first-to-N games.
Players want to tap a side each time it wins a game and see a live score, with a running tally across several rematches in one night.
The chat wants a shared scoreboard that only the named players can update, with undo for mis-taps and a rematch button once someone wins.
Unlike a poll or a split-the-bill tool, the chat needs a scoreboard that tracks wins to a fixed target.
dont_use_when: The group wants to vote on options or choose where to go; use a poll tool instead.
The group needs a bracket for many teams or a multi-round tournament schedule; use a tournament bracket tool instead.
People want to track money owed, bets, or splitting costs; use an expense splitter or a wager tracker instead.
More than two teams, teams larger than two players, or per-point scoring (such as to 21) are needed; this tool only counts whole game wins.
guarantees: Only players on one of the two teams can log wins, undo, or start a rematch.
A team can never exceed the target number of wins, and no wins are accepted once a series is decided.
Undo removes only the most recent game, and rematch is only possible after a team has reached the target.
Teams and target never change after the app is created.
Finished series are recorded with the final score, keeping at most the last 12.
